_why: Written 2026-08-18, the day this site was brought up to fleet parity from an index.html-only stub. privacy.html makes no_account/no_tracking/no_ads claims about the shipping build; this backs them with evidence from the actual app repo (~/Developer/DrVanus/hoardkeep, deployed here as www/) rather than removing the claims.

evidence: game.js:1480-1483 (the Lb module's own header comment): 'Identity: Supabase NATIVE ANONYMOUS sign-in (probed live 2026-08-13: mints a session directly, no relay/captcha).' There is no sign-up form, username field, or password anywhere in index.html or game.js.

game.js:1524-1528 (tag()): the WICK-XXXX leaderboard name is derived entirely from the anonymous session's own refresh token — 'no input UI', the function's own comment. The player never types or chooses a name.

HANDOFF.md OPEN work item 2b confirms the same: 'Client (Lb in game.js) uses NATIVE ANONYMOUS sign-in ... no relay/captcha, unlike Waddleton's own client.' No screen in the game (title, level select, Forge, Trials, result) contains a login, password, or profile UI.

grep across game.js for analytics/tracking SDK markers (gtag, Sentry, Firebase, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, PostHog) returns zero matches — the only third-party network calls in the file are the Supabase leaderboard endpoints under /auth/v1 and /rest/v1, disclosed on this same privacy page.
package.json (hoardkeep repo root) declares no analytics/crash-reporting dependency.
grep across game.js for ad SDK markers (AdMob, admob, ironSource, AppLovin, Unity Ads) returns zero matches.
design/DESIGN.md's v2 backlog lists 'IAP/ads' as an un-built future item, not a shipped feature — the current build has no purchase or ad surface anywhere in game.js or index.html.

No form or input field anywhere in index.html or game.js asks for a name, email, phone number, or any other personal detail — the only identity in the app is the auto-generated WICK-XXXX leaderboard tag (see no_account evidence).
The leaderboard payload itself is a wave-count integer plus a server-issued token (game.js Lb.flush(), 'p_board'/'p_name'/'p_value'); no personal field is ever constructed or sent.

contract_notes: Hoardling is an unlisted web PWA (not yet in the site's own sitemap-main.xml nav or in an app store; see HANDOFF.md 2b). It shares its hypersage.ai origin with the experimental Hoardling 3D build, so the anonymous leaderboard session and the sound-mute preference are shared browser-storage state between the two (same-origin localStorage) even though campaign save data and leaderboard boards are kept separate per game — privacy.html discloses this explicitly. Re-verify this contract if a store submission, an account system, or IAP/ads ever ships.
